game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Underground River Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the shadow ranger must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: In Underground River, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the rope bridge using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The rope bridge reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the rope bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Underground River'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Underground River.
